title: Fleet capacity delta replayer & scaling controls in Console
creator: Lena Chen
description:
Problem: Operators running Dedicated fleets lack a compact way to inspect past scaling decisions, reproduce the exact inputs that caused autoscale actions, and tune scaling controls without risky live edits. Current Console surfaces scaling presets and historical metrics separately; there is no single-pane ‘replay’ mode that shows what the fleet looked like, which policy fired, and how throughput moved before/after a change.

Goal: Deliver a Fleet Capacity Delta Replayer in the Console that: (1) shows an interactive timeline of capacity/throughput changes, (2) highlights policy triggers and override events, (3) enables a safe staging/preview of new autoscale parameters (policy sandbox), and (4) provides one-click rollbacks and recommended rollback windows for operators.

Scope: Console UI + read-only backend query surface for historical events (no change path to backend autoscaler in initial delivery). Includes: timeline visualization, delta diff panel (before/after), policy trigger inspector, simple policy edit sandbox (preview only), audit links to full change history, and an exportable change bundle for runbook/incident purposes. Integration points: metrics store (TSDB), audit event store, policy engine read model, and Console auth/audit layers.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Timeline shows capacity and observed throughput with zoom to 1h/6h/24h/7d.
2) Clicking a scaling event opens a delta panel with: capacity before, capacity after, triggered policy name, triggering signal (CPU, queued-reqs, latency), and associated request examples (if available).
3) Policy sandbox allows editing parameters and running a dry-run that computes predicted scaling decisions over historical data (read-only).
4) Operators can mark an event and request a rollback entry; rollback creates a draft policy change and a linked ticket in the operator queue.
5) All actions are audited and visible in the existing change history log; export of selected events to CSV/JSON works.
6) Performance: timeline load for a 30-day window <= 2s for fleets with <= 100 nodes.
7) UX validated with 3 operator interviews and sign-off from Ops PM.
notes:
Trade-offs: initial release will be read-only for safety and to reduce backend coordination. Dry-run predictions use last 90 days of metrics and current policy engine logic replicated in a query layer; accuracy expected ~92% for common workloads. We deprioritize live preview/apply in v1 to ensure audit/backfill is correct.

Open decisions: how to surface sensitive customer-identifying request examples (masking rules needed), retention window for events shown in replay UI (30/90/365 days), and whether rollback should be automated vs creating a draft for manual approval.

Mitigations: add a toggle in admin-only settings to enable request-sample visibility; default to masked. Implement rate-limited exports and require SSO admin role to perform rollbacks.

implementation_plan:
Phase 1 (v1 read-only): Backend read-model endpoints + TSDB downsampling, Console timeline + delta panel, policy trigger annotations, export.
Phase 2 (v1.1): Policy sandbox dry-run using replicated policy engine; admins can stage changes to operator queue.
Phase 3 (future): Safe apply/rollbacks with approval workflows and canary windows.

Rollout: feature-flagged to 10% orgs for two weeks, then 100% once metrics (latency, error rate, operator feedback) acceptable.
metrics: Primary: time-to-inspect (open->view delta) median < 5s; Secondary: number of rollbacks created; adoption: % of fleets using replay in first 30 days. Logging: events logged in audit store with 'replay.view' and 'replay.rollback_request' events.
UX_research: Planned: 3 operator sessions (scripted), track task completion on common incidents, capture SUS scores. Completed: 1 exploratory interview (Ops SRE) - feedback: need fast drill-down from fleet list.
engineering_notes:
ENG will implement a read-only API that composes TSDB + audit events. Downsampling strategy: pre-aggregate by 1m, 5m, 1h bins. FE to request specific ranges and resolution.
Estimate risk: medium due to query perf at scale.
qa_plan: End-to-end tests using replay fixture data (synthetic fleets), performance tests for 7d/30d windows, security tests to verify masking, acceptance criteria validation with 3 operator reps.
release_notes_draft: Console: Fleet Capacity Delta Replayer — Inspect past scaling events, preview policy dry-runs, and export change bundles. Initially read-only; admins can stage rollback requests. See docs for usage and RBAC.
communication: Notify Dedicated customers via in-console banner when feature is enabled for their org. Publish walkthrough doc and short demo video for operator training.
additional_context: This work is part of the broader Dedicated Capacity Controls initiative to make throughput guarantees more transparent and controllable without increasing cognitive load for operators. It complements autoscale policy improvements in ENG-87212 and the capacity sandboxing work in DES-2210.
